claims.text: Visible consumption signals unobserved wealth relative to a reference group, so the urge to set oneself apart intensifies when intra-group inequality is high and mean income is low.
objections: Does this product visibly signal my middle-class status to my reference group?

claims.text: Asset accumulation anchors new middle-class entrants, reducing vulnerability and the need to signal — conversely, conspicuous consumption is heightened precisely while status remains new or tenuous, before assets have accumulated enough to stabilize it.
objections: Will this product help me accumulate assets that anchor my position in the middle class?

claims.text: Black Tax is a social and moral obligation rooted in African communalism, so financial products are evaluated by their capacity to help manage extended-family duties without undermining personal financial health.
objections: Can I use this product to budget for my extended-family obligations without sacrificing my own financial health?

confidence: multi-source synthesis combining quantitative survey analysis, qualitative media framing analysis, and ethnographic fieldwork; mechanisms are robust across contexts but magnitudes are unknown.
